source.name: Wera: The Company (partnerships section)
source.quote: Wera is supporting the Germany SailGP Team this year as a tool partner during all pre-season preparations and is fully equipped to handle any fastening issues during the competitions.

source.note: Team page partner groups are rendered by script; contents confirmed on 2026-10-03 from the page's embedded data (Official Suppliers: Helly Hansen, Flaxta, Wera, AVEA).

summary: Deutsche Bank (co-title partner) presents Germany's team; Riedel - the company owned by the team's majority owner Thomas Riedel - and the Viessmann family group are official partners; Helly Hansen (Kontoor Brands), Flaxta, Wera (Bitburger Holding) and AVEA are official suppliers. The team's 'Purpose Partner' (Wir sind Wir, a pro-democracy campaign) is not recorded as a sponsor.
